read_on: Neon production fancy-block-96153928, default branch, through the connector

a.sql: SELECT now() AS read_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product, issued_date FROM cpc_outlook_curves WHERE method_version='cpc_curves_v1') a) AS v1_issuances, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product, issued_date FROM cpc_outlook_curves WHERE method_version='cpc_curves_v2') b) AS v2_issuances, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product, issued_date FROM cpc_outlook_curves WHERE method_version='cpc_curves_v1' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT product, issued_date FROM cpc_outlook_curves WHERE method_version='cpc_curves_v2') c) AS v1_lacking_v2

a_v2_only.sql: SELECT product, issued_date, count(*) AS rows FROM cpc_outlook_curves WHERE method_version='cpc_curves_v2' AND (product, issued_date) NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product, issued_date FROM cpc_outlook_curves WHERE method_version='cpc_curves_v1') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

b.sql: SELECT now() AS read_at, method_version, backtest_version, count(*) AS cells FROM cpc_curve_verdicts GROUP BY 2,3 ORDER BY 2,3

b_detail.sql: SELECT method_version, backtest_version, method_hash, rules_version, rules_hash, scored_at, truth_frontier, count(*) cells, count(*) FILTER (WHERE drawable) drawable, md5(pg_get_viewdef('v_cpc_curves_drawable'::regclass)) viewmd5 FROM cpc_curve_verdicts GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7 ORDER BY 1
